content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Jammu Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Dentist, 1 for General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO), and 1 for Paramedic.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Dentist: MDS (clinical branch) with at least 60% marks and Proficiency in computer office applications like MS Word, Excel and Power-point. Experience: 08 years' experience as Medical Officer (Dentist) in a recognized hospital. General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO): M.B.B.S. with at least 55% marks and Proficiency in computer office applications like MS Word, Excel and Power-point. Paramedic: GNM/ D.Pharma/Medical assistant with at least 60% marks and Proficiency in computer office applications like MS Word, Excel and Power-point. Experience: 03 years' experience as Paramedic/ Equivalent position in a recognized hospital.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Dentist: Maximum Age: 45 years General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO): Maximum Age: 40 years Paramedic: Maximum Age: 35 years Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) through an outsourcing agency for filling up various temporary healthcare positions.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for Dentist, General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO), and Paramedic positions across different advertisement numbers under the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in total?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for various healthcare positions including Dentist, GDMO, and Paramedic roles at IIT Jammu campus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications through the official portal is 30 September 2026. Candidates should apply beforehand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from ₹ 22,000/- to ₹ 95,000/- per month depending upon the specific post and qualifications of the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for a Dentist?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Dentist position must hold an MDS degree in a clinical branch with at least 60% marks along with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Paramedic post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Paramedic position is 35 years as per the guidelines specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through online mode by visiting the official recruitment portal provided by IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Jammu Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by a written test and/or interview conducted by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official application link?
faq.answer: You can access the official online application portal and notification PDF directly through the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
